mapper.select: SELECT id, from_blog_id, to_blog_id, neighbor_type, (deleted_at IS NULL) AS active FROM blog_neighbor WHERE from_blog_id = #{fromBlogId} AND to_blog_id = #{toBlogId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_neighbor (from_blog_id, to_blog_id, neighbor_type) VALUES (#{fromBlogId}, #{toBlogId}, #{type})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_neighbor SET deleted_at = NULL, neighbor_type = #{type} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_neighbor SET neighbor_type = #{type} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_neighbor SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS blogId, b.blog_name AS blogName, b.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, n.neighbor_type AS neighborType FROM blog_neighbor n JOIN blog_blog b ON b.id = n.to_blog_id WHERE n.from_blog_id = #{fromBlogId} AND n.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
